Choosing the desk-slack pane in a conversation no longer puts the cursor in the reply box, so `r` and `b` work there.

- The reply box no longer takes the focus when the pane is chosen: `r` reloads and `b` goes back instead of typing into it
- To reply, click the box or Tab to it; `Clear` still returns the cursor to it

## Install

```
/plugin install desk-look --marketplace KyongSik-Yoon/cc-desktop-mod
/plugin install desk-asana@cc-desktop-mod
/plugin install desk-slack@cc-desktop-mod
```

Already installed: `/desk-update` (or `claude plugin update desk-look`), then `/reload-plugins`.
